reasons.claim: 3 eligible species within 250 m, all VU site-bound forest fungi with 5 m uncertainty: Hydnellum gracilipes (123 m, 2019), Tricholoma matsutake (134 m, 2019), Sidera lenis (217 m, 2018). Listed threats include lack of continuity forest, old/large trees or dead wood, and ground disturbance from forestry.
7 site-bound forest NT species are also recorded within 250 m, several at 0 m (e.g. Hydnellum caeruleum, H. ferrugineum, H. peckii; 2018-2020). Effort inside the polygon shows 6 records of 4 species.
Completed felling overlaps 0.4% of the 31.69 ha polygon, so not ALREADY_FELLED.

uncertainties: Eligible records date from 2018-2019, so current occupancy is unknown.
8 coarse records within 250 m were excluded for coordinate uncertainty.
not_established: Whether the VU species occur inside the felling area today.
That the site is safe to fell.
next_action: Human reviewer should map the fungus records against the polygon (the NT records at 0 m in particular) and consider a field survey before felling starts.
